newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index up 1.43 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index up 1.43 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 0.88 points, or 1.43 percent, to 62.47 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index lost 17.21 points to a provisional 2,797.85.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 15.47 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
